translated: Ready, and... ProSeka AfterTalk! AfterTalk with You!
I'm Yui Ogura, the voice of Minori Hanasato from Momojan...
And I'm Rina Honnizumi, the voice of Shizuku Hinomori.
[CORNER: Fan Letter Corner] ProSeka AfterTalk is a program where we look back on the event while reading the letters you've sent in.
This time is the "with You" edition of AfterTalk. Did everyone enjoy the story?
I wonder how they liked it.
Looking at the comments... ah, everyone is saying "Good evening."
I'm sure everyone has their own thoughts, and the two of us will be diving deep into those later.
